notes.title: Thank You! (More Coming Soon)
notes.notes: [p]--- INCOMING TRANSMISSION ---[/p][p]Attention, crew of the Ptero![/p][p]First off, from all of us here at Dark Matter Observatory: Thank you![/p][p]We've been blown away by the number of people discovering Ventomori, and it's been wonderful watching as you all discover the little things that make the planet spin. Thank you to everyone who's contributed kind words and encouragement. We poured a lot into this project, and it warms our hearts to see people like you enjoying it.[/p][p]We'd like to assure you all, Ventomori is not an abandoned project. We've been listening to all your feedback, the suggestions and the bug reports, and we've put together a list for an upcoming "Patch 1."[/p][p]DMO is committed to making your experience the best it can be, and to that end, we would like to extend to you all an invitation to join our Discord server [url="https://discord.gg/vjgJvxykFK"]https://discord.gg/vjgJvxykFK[/url]. This is by far the best place to report bugs, make suggestions, or just chat with some of the devs.[/p][p]Thank you all, and remember:[/p][p]The Observatory thanks you for your Sacrifice[/p][p]--- END TRANSMISSION ---[/p]
